author: Mark Atwood
text: Decomposed into 10 per-method-family children (.6.1 ChatContact, .6.2 CustomEmoji, .6.3 Quota, .6.4 Blob, .6.5 SpaceBan, .6.6 SpaceInvite, .6.7 ReadPosition, .6.8 PresenceStatus, .6.9 PushSubscription, .6.10 grab-bag for smaller gaps in existing files). Helpers from bd:JMAP-26di.11 (closed) are available for all children — see crate-jmap-chat-client/tests/helpers.rs. Each child claimable independently; epic closes when all 10 children close. Releasing parent claim now so children surface on the ready frontier.
